topics.label: Introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic, reviews foundational cancer concepts, and outlines the session's core learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how stepwise genetic mutations and non-mutational epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages that drive clonal expansion.

topics.label: Cancer stem cells and the role of cellular origin
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore normal tissue hierarchies, cancer stem cell concepts, and experimental evidence demonstrating how cell of origin shapes tumor initiation in leukemia and colorectal cancer.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion, inflammation, and stromal dependence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics illustrate how environmental promoters, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stroma cooperate with mutations to drive tumor initiation, malignant outgrowth, and therapeutic responses.

topics.label: Techniques for investigating tumor heterogeneity and evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the experimental, computational, and spatial omics technologies used to resolve clonal dynamics and cell-microenvironment interactions.

topics.label: Multifactorial framework of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates genetic alterations, cellular hierarchies, epigenetic plasticity, and microenvironmental cues into a unified model of cancer development.

topics.label: Conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapeutics.
